club.founded_note: Formed 23 February 1966 by amalgamation of Ballymacward and Gurteen Junior Hurling clubs (club history; Wikipedia).
grounds: Páirc na nGael, Ballymacward (main grounds & clubhouse)
history_notes: Parish club of Ballymacward-Gurteen in East Galway.
Won the Galway Junior Championship in 1967 (first season after amalgamation), keeping the Pádraig Pearses name after both finalists had chosen it for the 50th anniversary of 1916.

Predecessor parish clubs: Gurteen Junior champions 1919; Ballymacward Junior champions 1940 (final played 1941 vs Loughrea) — per club history; Wikipedia lists Junior years as 1919 (Gurteen), 1941 (Ballymacward), 1967.
Fr Nicholas Murray of the parish transferred to neighbouring Fohenagh and won Galway SHC medals in 1959 and 1960 (club history; Galway Advertiser).
Do not confuse with Pádraig Pearses GAA (Roscommon).

score_notes.1979: Club history: beat Killimor 2-6 to 2-5 at Duggan Park.
score_notes.1991: Club history: beat Killimor 2-6 to 1-5 at Duggan Park after three games.

score_notes.2010: Club history: beat Killimor 1-10 to 1-8 at Kenny Park.
Club history: beat Ballyhaunis 1-14 to 1-10 at Athleague.

titles.title: Galway Junior Hurling Championship
titles.notes: First amalgam season; beat Oranmore-Maree (also newly named Pádraig Pearses). Wikipedia also lists predecessor Junior titles 1919 Gurteen and 1941 Ballymacward under the club honours roll.

titles.title: Galway Senior East Board Hurling Championship
titles.notes: Club history: defeated neighbours Fohenagh; first Senior title for the club. Not the county SHC.

titles.title: Galway Senior Hurling League

titles.title: Galway Minor A Hurling Championship
